conviction_note: Nothing unpriced found: every price-sensitive item for this quarter (Fontis close, bond paydown, Jade and Safira Petrobras awards, the Seagems strategic review, the CEO/CFO resignation) went out on NewsWeb before the print. What is left is an inferred Q3 recovery from Q2's vessel incidents that sits inside the company's own FY2026 guide, a dividend the cash walk covers, and a below-EBITDA make-whole charge. So p_up is 51 on a 4.5% scale (+0.09). It is 4.5 and not 7 because the guide is most likely reiterated and the period's one large swing item, the strategic review, resolves after the window. The findings sum to +0.4, the same sign and small; the two numbers agree.

findings.finding: The Q2 utilisation dip (93% vs 98.3% in Q1) came from Esmeralda and Jade incidents that the company says are 'completed'. A Q3 back near Q1's 98% would lift combined EBITDA from $42m toward $46-48m, but that lands inside the FY guide the company said already absorbed the incidents.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (dip, guide held) -3.33%; Q1 2026 (98% utilisation, EBITDA $46m) -4.36%; Q4 2025 (EBITDA $69m vs DNB Carnegie's $57m) +2.08%. Results-day reactions are mixed, and the two most recent were both negative.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the company told the market the incidents were finished and inside guidance. There was no Q3 trading update, so the actual number is not out. If the market were pricing a weak Q3 you would expect a drift down into the print; the stock is +0.9% over 5d and -2.6% over 20d, which is noise.
findings.independence: none (no independent vessel-utilisation series for Seagems; Vantris reports quarters to 31 Oct only in late December)

findings.finding: The USD 0.22 quarterly dividend (~$36m) looks covered. Paratus cash was ~$305m pro forma after Fontis, less $158m to the bond redemption, leaving ~$147m, with inflows from Seagems distributions ($30-41m a quarter) and 10% cash interest on the $237m seller credit (~$6m a quarter). A ninth unchanged USD 0.22 is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The dividend has been USD 0.22 every quarter since the IPO and has never surprised. No reaction to a change exists.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: a ~17% yield is the equity story (DNB Carnegie's targets are framed on it). The small positive is that the CEO exit and strategic review could have raised doubt about continuity; a maintained payout removes it. If the market feared a cut, the yield would sit visibly above the 16.5% DNB quoted in April. It does not (USD 0.88 x ~10.1 NOK/USD / 49.4 = ~18%).

findings.finding: The Q3 backlog will rebuild on two awards made in November: Safira (~$410m to Seagems, start Q4 2028) and Jade. DNB Carnegie (Norwegian) reads Jade as extended from mid-2027 to early 2028 and then offered a new period to 2032, lifting Paratus' EBITDA from that vessel by ~$4m a year to ~$40m. The release may give the Jade dayrate for the first time.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-11-09 (Jade bid accepted) close 47.50 -> 49.40 (+4.0%); 2026-09-18 (Safira partial award) 49.20 -> 50.20 (+2.0%); 2026-11-17 (Safira award, same day as the CEO resignation) 50.10 -> 48.75.
findings.original_quote: Her går fartøyet i utgangspunktet av kontrakt i midten av 2027, men denne ser nå i første omgang ut til å være forlenget til starten av 2028. Deretter er fartøyet tilbudt en ny periode fram til 2032. ... venter vi at avtalen vil kunne løfte EBITDA-bidraget fra denne enheten med rundt USD 4 mill. pr. år til rundt USD 40 mill. pr. år. (The vessel initially comes off contract in mid-2027 but now appears to be extended to early 2028, and is then offered a new period to 2032; we expect the deal to lift this unit's EBITDA contribution by about USD 4m a year to about USD 40m a year.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: both awards were announced on NewsWeb and the stock moved on each. The only unpriced part is the Jade dayrate and duration, which Paratus has not published. If the market already held DNB's ~$40m a year, a confirmed figure near it would move nothing; the sign comes only if the rate beats it.

findings.finding: Q3 net income will carry the $8.7m make-whole premium on the 16 Sep 2026 partial redemption of the 2029 bonds, plus a likely write-off of unamortised issuance costs. That is about $0.05 a share against quarterly EPS that ran $0.06-0.20, so reported EPS can miss mechanically. It sits below EBITDA and has no path to the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior debt-extinguishment quarter is observable for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The premium is public, but an aggregator EPS consensus may not exclude it, so headline EPS screens could print a miss. Holders value the stock on EBITDA and the dividend, so this is sized at a fraction.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the lean: priced_lean +0.13 and a flat run-up (5d +0.9%, 20d -2.6%) describe a name with nothing priced either way, which is what the hunt found.
language_note: DNB Carnegie's Norwegian 'Dagens aksjetips' (9 Nov 2026) carried the only quantified read on the Jade award: extension from mid-2027 to early 2028, a new period to 2032, and EBITDA from that vessel rising ~$4m a year to ~$40m for Paratus. The company's English release gave no dayrate or duration.

DNB Carnegie's Norwegian tips also carry the dividend-yield framing (16.5% on its estimates, April 2026) and the NOK 65 target. The filings themselves are English-only on NewsWeb, so the Norwegian half added sell-side colour and no primary document.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' / guidance reiterated median 2.3% against numbers-new 7.4%: no Q3 pre-release, so abs_move rose from 4.0 to 4.5. Strategic-review commentary in the release is a live tail ('in a live bid, results are noise' is the nearest rule, though no offer exists).
'A finding that lands inside what the company already guided': the Q3 recovery finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2, because the company told the market the Q2 incidents were already inside guidance.
'Too small about the move' moved abs_move only; p_up stays at 51 because the last two results days were both sold (-4.36, -3.33).
